sections.title: At a glance
sections.body: Tôi cần giấy thông hành tạm thời is the short line for naming what you need next. It works best when temporary travel document is visible on your phone, ticket, note, shelf, or in the situation around you.

sections.title: Quick say
sections.body: Say Tôi cần giấy thông hành tạm thời with the object, screen, or note visible. Beginners should keep the main travel detail visible and say the short sentence once.
